strings.name: Sam Kerr
strings.summary: Kerr's movement, heading and finishing built a career across Australia, the United States and England. She won scoring awards in each league, helped Chelsea to repeated titles and broadened Australian women's football's public reach. A serious ACL injury caused a long absence in 2024; a British jury acquitted her of harassment in 2025. In 2026 she left Chelsea and signed with former club Gotham through the 2030 season.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through November 16, 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: An Australian international and leading league scorer who expanded the international influence of Oceania's women's football.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birthplace
strings.facts.f1.value: Born in East Fremantle, Western Australia.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Scorer across leagues
strings.highlights.h1.text: Won Golden Boots in Australia's W-League, the NWSL and England's WSL.
strings.facts.f2.label: Education and early training
strings.facts.f2.value: Played Australian rules football before switching codes and joining Perth Glory as a teenager.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Chelsea championship core
strings.highlights.h2.text: Helped Chelsea win five WSL titles and multiple cups during her spell.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Returns to Gotham
strings.timeline.t1.text: The club announced a contract through 2030, with arrival planned for July after signing.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Acquitted of harassment
strings.timeline.t2.text: A British jury found her not guilty of racially aggravated harassment of a police officer.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Serious ACL injury
strings.timeline.t3.text: An injury during Chelsea training led to a long rehabilitation.
strings.timeline.t4.title: World Cup semifinal goal
strings.timeline.t4.text: Scored from distance against England; Australia ultimately finished fourth.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Chelsea debut
strings.timeline.t5.text: Moved to England, beginning a spell with repeated titles and scoring awards.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Chicago Red Stars move
strings.timeline.t6.text: Continued prolific NWSL scoring and expanded her US professional career.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Joins Sky Blue
strings.timeline.t7.text: Joined the club later renamed Gotham for a major NWSL stage.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Senior international debut
strings.timeline.t8.text: Represented Australia at fifteen, starting a long national-team career.
